details:
In general, I am happy with the addition of a perf-gate system for Instances. I think it will be a boon to know ahead of time that there is a perf limit on an instance and that it will automatically hide avatars outside of those limits in what has been declared to potentially be an instance requiring such. I like that I'm not forced to change avatars and it simply hides me for others if I exceed the set limit. These are all great features.

However, it has been many years since VRChat shifted their stance from taking control of user experience themselves to leaving the control with the user. I am very against giving my control over my experience to others. It feels like a regression to be forced to adhere to someone else's preferred experience or what they think my experience should be.

So, while I do understand the reasoning for disallowing force-show on a social comfort level, and I really do like the other features, I can't see myself using this gating system if I have to surrender my control of experience or force others to do so.

Therefore, I would like to request a simple compromise in the interest of ensuring this feature is more complete and covers more use-cases by way of a toggle for whether allowing force-showing others' avatars is On or Off, with it defaulted to Off in the interest of the original vision.

Thank you.
title: Performance-Gated Instance OPTION to allow Force-Show for avatars.
